Name: THRUSTERS_PARAM_PC_ST
Description: Thruster particle effects for player ACs. Each row sets, for every movement state (boosting, Quick Boost, Assault Boost, hovering, braking, turning, falling and the tank and hover leg states), the particle effect, its management slot and how it is placed and scaled.

Fields.Name: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the thruster effects are spawned at. -1: the placement position. When a booster is specified, this is the ID of a dummy poly on the booster.

Fields.Name: Main: SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle ID of the thruster effect played in this state.

Fields.Name: Main: Slot Number
Fields.Description: Management slot number for the effect. -1: not managed. Do not use a looping particle effect without a management slot.

Fields.Name: Main: RPC Type
Fields.Description: RPC value that drives the effect, for example to change its size with the character's horizontal movement speed. When set to 1, the value actually used is 60000.

Fields.Name: Main: Direction Mode
Fields.Description: 0: keep the effect's direction, 1: align the effect horizontally.

Fields.Name: Main: Follow Dummy Polygon
Fields.Description: Whether the effect follows the dummy poly. 0: does not follow, 1: follows.

Fields.Name: Main: Erase After Action
Fields.Description: Whether the effect is removed when the action ends. 0: kept, 1: removed.

Fields.Name: Main: Show While Hidden
Fields.Description: Keeps the effect visible while the character is hidden (camouflaged). 0: the effect disappears, 1: the effect stays.

Fields.Name: Main: Play on Tanks
Fields.Description: Whether the effect plays when the AC has tank legs. 0: not played, 1: played.

Fields.Name: Main: SFX Scale
Fields.Description: Scale of the particle effect.
